sin.name: sentence-method-name
sin.description: A method is named as a sentence: a function word in it, an article, a pronoun, an adverb or a preposition phrase, such as typed_one_by_one, hold_the_stop, tried_again, speaks_to_the_user.
sin.rule: A method name is a verb and its object, in the imperative, without articles, pronouns, adverbs or preposition phrases: type_lines, hold_stop, retry, speak_to_user.
